FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Fruit & Vegetable Flashcards for Preschoolers

Sixteen cards about the foods children see every day: eight fruits, eight vegetables, every one with its own page, the words to say together and one thing to try at snack time.

THE CARDS

Every card in the set.

Each card has its own page with the picture, the words to say and one thing to try together. Tap any card to open it.

AppleCard 1 of 16BananaCard 2 of 16OrangeCard 3 of 16StrawberryCard 4 of 16GrapesCard 5 of 16WatermelonCard 6 of 16PineappleCard 7 of 16MangoCard 8 of 16CarrotCard 9 of 16PotatoCard 10 of 16TomatoCard 11 of 16CucumberCard 12 of 16BroccoliCard 13 of 16CornCard 14 of 16OnionCard 15 of 16PumpkinCard 16 of 16
HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Four ways that work.

You do not need a plan or a printer schedule. Pick one idea, try it for two minutes and see what happens.

  1. 01

    Name it, then find it in the kitchen

    The pair is the whole lesson: “apple!” — then hunt the fruit bowl together. The word sticks when the real food lands in your child’s hand.

  2. 02

    Sort the cards, then sort the snack

    Fruit cards on one plate, vegetable cards on another — then do it for real with an apple and a carrot. Sorting food is a game children can eat.

  3. 03

    Play the color rows

    Which foods are red? Which are green? Lay the cards out in color rows together — the kitchen becomes a rainbow.

  4. 04

    Take one card shopping

    Hand your child the carrot card at the market and let them find its twin in the pile. One matched carrot is a whole class.
